description: Blank white canvas becomes first composition: central-bank building character with big eyes rises from bottom centre-right; two tilted dark news-headline cards drop in at top left and top right.
Orange percent coin rises out from behind the building roof to above it (centre); a third dark headline card enters at right. Building eyes look up.
One-frame pop of another tilted dark news card at lower left, below the older-left card; coin and building unchanged.
One-frame pop of a further dark news card at lower right with a portrait thumbnail; rest of composition unchanged.
Whole composition (cards, coin, building) replaced by a browser capture of an official press-release page at left and a smiling stick man with pointer at right.
Yellow text-highlight begins at the start of the first body line of the press-release page (left); cursor sits by the date.
Yellow highlight sweeps rightward across first two body lines of the press release while the date field shows a blue selection; man unchanged.
Highlight on second body line extends further right ('...raise the target range ... by 1/4'); date stays blue-selected.
Both highlighted body lines grow a few words further to the right; cursor shifts. Left-centre of page.
Second-line yellow highlight advances to 'percentage point'; small mouse cursor moves.
Man's pointer arm changes: pointer stick swings from lying low across his body to raised diagonal pointing up-left at the page text.
Highlight now reaches '3/4 to 4 percent,' on the third line; pointer pose and page otherwise stable; cursor drifts.
Only the mouse-cursor arrow moves away from the Share icon near the page left; no content change.
Cursor arrow repositions near the page text; date selection toggles; no visible content change otherwise.
Press-release page and man replaced by empty white canvas with a single red calendar icon at top left.
Second identical calendar icon appears to the right of the first at top left.
Third calendar icon appears in the top-left row; three icons now.

Calendar row cut (see SD001) to a four-person table scene (bottom centre/right) with a speech bubble reading 'EGG FIRST!' appearing around f276; at about f300 replaced by the press-release page plus smiling man. Contains two replacements.
Blue text selection begins on the last digit of the date 'July 29, 2026' at top left of the page; I-beam cursor there.
Blue date selection widens to cover '2026'.
Date selection completes across 'July 29, 2026'; cursor moves.
Cursor moves from date area down to the first body line; selection kept; no new content.
Man's pointer arm rises from low to diagonal pointing at the first body line; tiny yellow highlight starts on 'The'.
Yellow highlight sweeps the full first body line ('The Federal Open Market Committee ... 9-3 vote:'); pointer held; cursor moves.
Man's face goes from smile to flat neutral mouth and pointer drops from raised to lying across his body; right side of frame.
Date selection changes from blue to grey; text highlight state slightly updated near the top lines; no new objects.
Cursor arrow drifts over the lower body text; no content change.
Pointer swings from diagonal rest to lowered horizontal toward the bottom text lines; yellow highlight begins at 'Voting' on the lower paragraph.
Yellow highlight sweeps along lower paragraph 'Voting against the monetary policy action were Beth M. Hammack, Neel Kashkari...'; has I-frame but content change is real.
Lower-paragraph highlight extends by a few words; cursor hand/arrow moves near the contact email.
Highlight wraps to second line of lower paragraph ('who preferred to raise the target').
Highlight on second lower line extends to 'range'; cursor I-beam near the phone number.
Second lower-line highlight grows to 'by 1/4 percentage point at this' across the lower page text.
Highlight finishes on 'meeting'; cursor moves right of the lower text.
Only the mouse cursor moves around the end of the highlighted lines; no content change.
Browser capture pans horizontally: the old page (July date) with man slides out left while a second page (September date, text differs, no man) slides in from right; man exits with the old page.
Pan settling: both pages still shifted left; strip continues to slide until the right-hand page occupies the canvas.
Pan nearly finished; yellow highlight on new page first body line extends to 'release by'; cursor repositions.
Highlight extends on second line of new page ('The Committee decided to raise the target range') while pan settles.
On the old left-page strip the first-line highlight turns orange (colour change); right page highlights unchanged.
Highlight spreads over '3/4 to 4 percent,' on the third line of the new page.
Cursor arrow moves from the Share icon to below it; date selection stays blue; no content change.
Highlight completes '3/4 to 4 percent,' with comma; cursor moves right.
Stick man (puzzled face, one arm up) pops in over the right-hand part of the page near lower centre-right; page behind unchanged.
No visible content change in pre, changed frame or stable tiles; sub-threshold noise near the page lower right.
Press-release page with man replaced by white canvas holding a puzzled stick man (left-centre) and a grey laptop marked CF at right; I-frame present.
Biography page slides in from the right edge (portrait photo top, text block right); laptop disappears and man switches to smile with pointer at left.
Man's pointer arm changes: pointer lowered across body becomes raised toward the portrait.
Man's free arm (left side of his torso) goes from folded to a V-shape.
Biography page and pointing man replaced by a quote text block at top, red up-arrows (left) and a glasses-wearing man at a desk with laptop (right); arrows enter from left.
Yellow highlight begins on the word 'was' in the quote text (centre-top). Man and arrows unchanged.
Highlight extends over 'was not abat' on quote line two. Man and arrows unchanged.
Highlight continues to 'on its ow' on line two. Man and arrows unchanged.
Highlight reaches 'monetary' at the end of line two. Man and arrows unchanged.
Highlight begins on line three ('polic'). Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'policy was no'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'not doing'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'enough'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'to re'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'restrain ex'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Line-three highlight reaches 'excess dem'. Man and arrows unchanged.
Highlight completes through 'demand.' ending the quote emphasis. Man and arrows unchanged.
Quote scene (text, arrows, man at desk) replaced by a lone smiling stick man (eyes closed) holding an open dictionary with a flag, centred on white.
Dictionary man disappears; new composition shows red up-arrows with a pair of angry eyes at right-centre, rest empty. Machine class was partial/additive; real change is a full replacement.
Speech bubble appears left of the arrows/eyes reading 'I'm here to stay b*tch!' (asterisk censored).
Orange percent coin with worried eyes enters from lower-left, rises and shrinks to rest at far left of the bubble.
Green dollar bill appears under the coin at lower left.
Second and third dollar bills appear in a row along the bottom, one after another.
Fourth dollar bill appears at the right end of the bottom row; spacing re-flows.
Coin, bubble, arrows, eyes and bills replaced by a lone smiling stick man with arms spread out, centred.
Green treasury document drawing appears left of the man ('United States Treasury').
Cream/red bond certificate with a UK flag appears top-left ('TREASURY BOND', '10,000').
Light green certificate appears at right ('Government of Japan').
Yellow certificate with the word BOND appears top-right of the man.
No visible change on the man's torso; sub-threshold noise.
Man's arms change from spread-out to bent hands-on-hips style; torso region centre.
All bond drawings and man cut to a blank canvas, then a dark financial-news headline card slides in from the right over the top area (SD003).
Orange percent coin and green 'United States Treasury' certificate drawing pop into the lower centre-right in one frame beneath the unchanged dark news-headline card.
Smiling-eyed Earth character (blue/green globe, white swoosh mouth, round eyes) pops in at lower left beside the coin and certificate in one frame.
Earth character's black pupils shift right inside the white eyes (glance); globe body, coin, certificate and headline card unchanged.
No clear content change visible between pre and stable frames; changed bbox spans headline highlight and upper Earth; possible tiny highlighter or pupil shift, not confirmable.
Yellow-green highlighter now covers 'level since' in the headline (previously blue link text); red box around '5.04%' unchanged.
Hard cut from Earth/coin/certificate under headline card to a Chrome PDF-viewer capture (dark thumbnail sidebar, white page) of an economics paper; page then scrolls from title block to body text.
No visible content change in the PDF viewer between pre and stable; cursor and page identical.
PDF page scrolls down from page 1 body to the end of page 1 and start of page 2; thumbnail selection moves from page 1 to page 2; viewer chrome static.
Page 2 text continues scrolling upward inside the PDF viewer, ending near the page-2 footnote and 'Goals and Definitions' heading.
Mouse cursor moves from the dark right margin onto the body text, becoming an I-beam near the '2022' line; page itself unchanged.
Blue text-selection highlight appears on the word 'the' in the line beginning 'tightening that began in 2022' as the I-beam starts a drag selection.
Blue text selection jumps to cover 'the Federal Reserve has tightened monetary policy' plus the next line 'to combat inflation eleven previous times since 1965' in one frame.
Blue selection extends to the last characters of '1965' with the I-beam at the end of the selected text; rest of page unchanged.
Cursor leaves the selected text, becoming an arrow, and travels to the dark right margin; selection stays in place.
Arrow cursor drifts a few pixels in the right margin of the PDF viewer; no page content changes.

PDF viewer scrolls quickly through pages to a table page and enlarges, then hard-replaced by a full-frame 'Table 1: The Eleven Monetary Policy Tightenings since 1965' beside a new peach-faced stick-figure presenter with brown pointer.
Yellow highlighter wipes left to right over table row 1 (Sept. 1965-Nov. 1966 ... 'Quite soft-but was it a landing?').
Second yellow highlighter wipe over table row 4 (Jan. 1977-Apr. 1980 ... Hard), row 1 highlight remaining.
Stick figure's long brown pointer swings from aiming at the table to hanging diagonally down-left across the torso; body, table and highlights unchanged.
Handwritten black marker text '1 1/2 year,' appears at lower centre-right under the table in one frame.
Handwritten text 'added 4%' appears right after '1 1/2 year,' on the same baseline at lower right in one frame.
Table-plus-presenter scene replaced by a lone stick figure centred on white: spiky black hair, skeptical raised eyebrow, flat mouth, one hand raised, other on hip; table and text removed.
Lone stick figure replaced by an illustrated brown-haired tan-faced character at left with a tiny green stroke, orange percent coin and Treasury certificate at right.
Thick green zig-zag rising arrow is drawn on from lower-left start up to an upper-right arrowhead between the character and the coin/certificate.
Brown-haired character's idle pose flips: hooked raised hand moves from the right side of the torso to the left and the hair wing swaps; arrow, coin, certificate static.
Character flips back to the earlier idle pose (hooked hand on right of torso, hair wing left); everything else static.
Speech bubble reading 'Done!' appears right of the character, partly covering the arrow and coin, while the character's arms change to a shrug pose.
Character scene replaced by a screenshot of a central-bank website page (Policy Tools / Open Market Operations Archive with 2002 and 2001 rate tables) on the left two-thirds, white margin right.
Website page scrolls down through older yearly rate tables while a profile card (portrait, 'Alan Greenspan', 'Chairman, Board of Governors, 1987-2006', bio paragraph) slides in from the right edge.
Website page scrolls a further short distance (1999 table moves off the top) under the static profile card; 6 frames.
Page, profile card and cursor positions identical in pre and stable; only residual scroll settle at most.
Page keeps scrolling while the profile card drifts down and out, then the page zooms in about 1.6x to fill centre with 1998-1996 tables; amber highlights appear on the 1997 and 1996 rows.
Stick figure (black spiky hair, smile, one leg kicked up) appears at lower right overlapping the 1997/1996 tables in one frame.
Stick figure vanishes from the lower right in one frame; an orange-red highlight begins at the left end of the 'September 29' row.
Orange-red highlighter wipes left to right across the 'September 29' table row (1998).
No visible content change between pre and stable in the zoomed tables; sub-threshold noise.

Zoomed rate-table page replaced by a central-bank 'Federal Open Market Committee' page (FOMC projections materials, accessible version) with a smiling stick figure and lowered pointer overlapping at right.
FOMC page scrolls down from the text summary into projection tables (GDP, unemployment, inflation, 2021-2029 columns); stick figure at right static.
Page and stick figure identical between pre and stable; no visible change.
Page scroll continues past unemployment and inflation tables to the 'Figure 2' midpoint table and part of Figure 3.A; figure static.
Page scrolls about 50 px while the stick figure's pointer arm swings up so the pointer tip touches the Figure 2 table; 3 frames.
Page zooms in about 1.9x to full-frame Figure 2 table ('Midpoint of target range...') while the stick figure slides out right; arrow cursor and a blue bar over the '2026' header appear.
Blue vertical stroke is drawn down the left edge of the '2026' column starting from its header.
Blue stroke continues down the left edge to the table bottom, then turns and begins running right along the bottom edge.
Blue bottom edge of the column box finishes and the right edge begins rising upward.
Blue column box right edge completes, magenta outlines are drawn around the '4.375' and '4.125' rows, and an orange percent coin pops in at upper right.
Arrow mouse cursor to the right of the coin disappears; table, boxes and coin unchanged.
Red-and-white calendar icon with six red dots pops in below the percent coin at right in one frame.
Full-frame FOMC dot-plot table with coin and calendar replaced by a smiling stick figure at left and a think-tank article screenshot ('Trusted Insights for What's Ahead' bullets on FOMC) at right.
Mouse cursor moves downward within the article text area at right; figure and page otherwise unchanged.
Article scrolls up to its top, revealing a dark banner headline about a September FOMC preview; an 'Author' card slides in at right and the pointer swings up toward the headline.
'Author' card (portrait, name, 'Senior US Economist', 'Read Bio') leaves to the right/down while a thin red stroke starts drawing above the headline.
Red rectangle around the headline looks complete in both pre and stable; no visible content change.
Stick figure's smile turns to a frown and pointer drops to a lowered diagonal while the article scrolls down about 200 px, moving the red-boxed headline banner off the top.
Mouse arrow cursor moves up from lower right of the article text to mid-right; frowning figure and page static.
Pointer arm swings from diagonal across the torso to a horizontal arm pointing right at the third bullet; a yellow highlight appears on the word 'We' at the bullet start.
Yellow highlighter wipes across the three lines of the bullet 'We now anticipate three consecutive rate hikes in September, October, and December...' line by line.
Frowning figure and highlighted article replaced by a Chrome PDF-viewer capture of a New York Fed staff report (title page, authors, Staff Report no. 421, January 2010).
Cursor and PDF page identical between pre and stable; no visible change.
PDF page scrolls down from the title page to page 2 start (title block, abstract); thumbnail selection moves to page 2.
Viewer, thumbnails and cursor identical in pre and stable; no visible change.
PDF scrolls further through page 2 (abstract, key words, footnote) toward the 'I. Introduction' heading.
PDF scrolls to 'I. Introduction' body text; thumbnail selection moves to page 3.
PDF scrolls through Introduction paragraphs to the next page break and the start of the page with 'Figure 1'.
PDF scrolls to Figure 1 (fed funds rate line chart with grey recession bands); thumbnail selection moves to page 4.
PDF viewer chrome zooms/crops away so the paper page fills the frame at about 1.7x around Figure 1, and a smiling stick figure with pointer appears at right aiming at the chart.
About fifteen thin magenta vertical lines appear at once over the chart's tightening-cycle grid lines; figure and text static.
Magenta lines vanish; stick figure changes from smiling with raised pointer to flat mouth with pointer lowered diagonally; an arrow cursor appears over the chart's right side.
Cursor, chart and figure identical in pre and stable; no visible change.
Document scrolls from the chart down through the paragraph and footnote to the page break and next page text; figure static, cursor stays.
Scroll continues to 'Figure 2' (scatter chart of unemployment increase vs spread); the stick figure's pointer swings up and aims at the text.
Orange highlighter wipes across the first two text lines ('Ten of these tightening cycles were followed by recessions within 18 months...').
Pointer swings from aimed at the text to lowered diagonal; a small yellow highlight begins on 'Of the' in line two.
Yellow highlighter continues from 'Of the four monetary cycles' across lines three and four of the paragraph, left to right per line.
A portrait card (older man in glasses and suit, small bio paragraph, handwritten 'Source: Fullbright') rises from the bottom over the left half of the chart area.
Stick figure's face changes from flat mouth to a worried look: raised angled eyebrows, wider eyes and an open mouth with pink tongue.
Portrait card slides back down and out revealing the scatter chart again, and the figure's face returns to a flat-mouth neutral look.
Green highlight appears behind the words 'The' in the paper screenshot's fourth text line, upper-centre-left; stick figure and other highlights unchanged.
Green marker highlight sweeps left to right across the fifth paragraph line (about 'soft landings') in the paper screenshot while the figure with pointer stays static.
Hard cut from paper screenshot with pointer figure to white canvas with green US-map character at left and handwritten '3 times' at top right.
Red handwritten text 'in 50 years.' appears right of the map character under '3 times', upper right.
Map character's smile lines change to drooping frown strokes; an orange percent circle rises from lower centre-right to right of the map beside the red text.
Map character's eyes go half-lidded, mouth becomes relaxed smile, and a speech bubble 'Crisis averted!' appears lower right of the map.
Hard cut from map character scene to news-card (dark rectangle top) over bank-building icon bottom-left and treasury-note icon bottom-right.
Top news-search card swaps to a different outlet card (smaller seal thumbnail, different headline); building and treasury icons unchanged.
Top news card swaps to another outlet card with portrait thumbnail and two-line headline; bottom icons unchanged.
Top news card swaps to another outlet card (business channel) with new headline and speaker photo; bottom icons unchanged.
Top news card swaps to a further outlet card with one-line headline 'Fed Delivers First Rate Hike...'; bottom icons unchanged.
News card and both icons removed; white canvas now holds only the green map character in lower-left.
Orange percent icon ringed by red circular arrows enters from top-left edge, travels across to lower right; map character gets worried half-lidded face and a red bump on its upper area.
Hard cut from map character and percent icon to teacher stick figure left with pointer at green chalkboard reading 'The history'.
Chalkboard scene replaced at f3810 by white canvas; green zigzag rising arrow draws on from bottom-left to upper right while orange percent circle slides to top-left.
Illustrated stack of papers labelled 'MORTGAGE' appears at top right above the green arrow.
Large brick house with red roof and bushes appears lower centre-right.
First green money bag with dollar sign appears right of the house, lower right.
Second money bag appears overlapping the first, right of the house.
Third money bag appears between and above the two others, forming a pile right of the house.
Arrow, percent circle, mortgage papers, house and money bags replaced by curly grey-haired stick figure centre, blue house left, and a woman with piggy bank and coin at right.
Machine class partial/additive is wrong: whole prior scene (curly figure, blue house, piggy bank woman) replaced by one frowning black-haired stick figure centred on empty canvas.
Frowning stick figure replaced by row of three small houses with a saw-wielding man left-centre and a hammer-holding woman with yellow hair right.
Saw man and hammer woman disappear; the three houses remain in place.
Three houses replaced by large close-up of a worried dark-haired figure holding a dollar bill, cropped at frame top and bottom.
Close-up figure replaced by green US-map character centred, half-lidded eyes, smile, with translucent dollar bill on its eastern region.
Very faint pale-cyan ice-cube shape begins to fade in behind the map character (first frame of the freezing overlay).
Pale then saturated teal ice cube fades in over and around the map character, tinting the map teal, over 7 frames.
Hard cut from ice-block map to full-bleed illustrated war scene: grey ruined city, stormy sky, helmeted soldier beside a huge red flag with yellow star and emblem.
Hard cut from full-bleed war scene to white canvas with one small house and skyscraper at top-left.
A second small house and second skyscraper appear overlapping the first cluster, top-left.
Smiling stick figure with spiky black hair enters lower-centre below the building cluster.
Columned central-bank building labelled 'FEDERAL RESERVE' appears right of the stick figure.
Cluster, figure and bank building replaced by a single larger house and skyscraper centred on empty canvas.
House and skyscraper shatter into fragment tiles (white grid squares) and a bordered 'Figure 1' dot chart scrolls into the full frame, ending on its top.
Dot chart replaced by stacked-bar chart of mortgage rate shares with title and colour legend.
No visible content change in stacked-bar chart; sub-threshold noise over chart bars.
No visible content change in stacked-bar chart across bar region; sub-threshold noise.
Chart bars desaturate to greys, leaving only the last column coloured; a stick figure with pointer enters at top right.
Grey chart with pointer figure appears identical across 9 frames; no visible change.
Pointer figure slides down along right edge while the topmost coloured segment of the final bar column turns grey.
Pointer figure slides further down while next coloured segment of the last column is greyed, leaving cyan and blue segments.
Chart and pointer figure replaced by news card top-centre, worried brown-skinned figure with bow tie at left and big house at right.
Top news card swaps to a different outlet card with new headline and thumbnail; figure and house unchanged.
Red '4%' text and a MORTGAGE papers icon appear between figure and house; news card text briefly glitches.
News card swaps to another outlet card with a for-sale-sign thumbnail.
News card swaps to another outlet card with new headline.
News card, figure, mortgage papers and house look identical across 4 frames; no visible change.
News card swaps to another outlet card with a walking-person thumbnail.
Cartoon scene replaced by a central-bank web page screenshot 'Monetary Policy Report - July 2026' centred on white canvas.
Web page screenshot identical across frames; no visible change.
Web page screenshot scrolls quickly down the document, passing charts, and ends on an enlarged crop of a section 'Residential investment growth remains weak' with a line chart.
Yellow highlight extends across the second text line ('secured mortgages ... from moving.') of the paragraph, completing a two-line highlight.
Document page replaced by smiling black-haired stick figure holding an open dictionary, centred on white.
Dictionary figure replaced by brown-haired figure centre, mortgage papers with green '4%' and small house left, mortgage papers with red '7%' and large house right.
Centre figure's arm pose swaps (raised hand moves to its other side); props and numbers unchanged.
Centre figure's arms swap to a shrug pose with one arm out and one raised; props unchanged.
Speech bubble 'It's small but... oh well!' appears above and right of centre figure, covering the right mortgage papers.
Cartoon scene replaced by a line chart 'Existing Home Sales' with three lines and axes, full frame.
The dark Total line is recoloured to thick magenta progressively from left to right across the chart.
Thick red hand-drawn arrow appears at the chart's right end pointing at the final point of the magenta line.
Frowning stick figure with black hair appears at bottom-left, overlapping the chart's left axis.
Line chart and frowning figure replaced by navy bar chart 'Existing Homes, All Types: Sales, Millions'.
The rightmost (final-year) bar turns red.
The leftmost (first-year) bar turns red.
Bar chart replaced by a teal ice cube containing a house and a skyscraper, centred.
Ice cube replaced by a single stick figure with raised eyebrow and one arm up, centred.
Machine class partial/additive is wrong: figure removed and columned bank building with large eyes appears at upper-left instead.
Small house and grey skyscraper appear lower right of the bank-building character.
House and skyscraper tumble and rotate off toward the right edge, leaving only the bank-building character.
The bank-building character's pupils shift position within its large eyes (gaze shift).
Large orange percent circle drops in right of the bank building while its eyes turn toward it.
Bank building and percent circle cut to white, then a profile page (portrait and bio) appears left and a Federal speech web page slides in from the right edge.
Right-hand speech web page scrolls upward; left profile page static.
Right-hand speech web page continues scrolling upward; left profile static.
Right-hand web page scroll continues and decelerates; left profile static.
A small grey text-selection box on the word 'expanding' in the right web page disappears.

Camera push/pan: bio-card plus Fed-site composition slides left and scales up until the right-hand speech-page text fills frame; smiling pointer-stick character appears at lower right by the last frame.
Yellow marker highlight on the paragraph grows a few letters (Eve to Ever-exp); I-beam text cursor shifts slightly. Page and character unchanged.
Yellow highlight on the word run Ever-expanding pools extends to the full phrase on line one; text cursor moves down-left over the paragraph. Character static.
Highlight finishes 'of' at end of line one and begins a new yellow sliver at the start of the next line ('c' of capital). Small bbox over the paragraph.
Second-line highlight grows from 'capital' to 'capital are' as the cursor drifts right across the paragraph. Rest of page and character unchanged.
Line-two highlight continues from 'capital are' to 'capital are pouring into AI-'; mouse cursor travels over the paragraph lines below. No layout change.
Highlight on line two lengthens by a few letters (AI- to AI-rel); cursor changes from I-beam to arrow near the lower text lines.
Highlight on line two extends from 'AI-related' to 'infrastructure of all'; cursor hops between I-beam and arrow. Page static.
Line-two highlight reaches 'of all sorts'; cursor moves right across the paragraph. Characters and page unchanged.
Mouse arrow cursor over the right end of the paragraph disappears or moves out of the tracked area; no text or highlight change.
Hard cut from Fed-speech page with pointer character to blank white canvas holding a centred cream columned building icon labelled with two words on its pediment.
Hard cut from the building icon to a lone stick figure at lower left: dark hair, navy tie, open surprised mouth, right arm extended sideways. Rest of canvas blank.
A grey isometric chip/circuit-board prop with three small cubes pops in at centre-right of the canvas beside the tie character. Single-frame pop, no tween.
Speech bubble 'Look at those guys!!!' pops in above the character, tail pointing to his head, upper centre-left. Single-frame appearance.
Hard cut to a giant close-up of a different character: tan round face, spiky black hair, one raised eyebrow, flat mouth, left side of frame; circuit board and bubble gone.
Green money bag with yellow dollar sign pops in right of the large face, centre of frame. Single-frame appearance.
Large red question mark with black outline pops in to the right of the money bag, right of centre. Single-frame appearance.

Hard cut from face, money bag and question mark to a left-aligned phone-width investment-bank article screenshot: logo, section tag, two-line headline, two authors, date and hero photo of curved architecture.
Mouse arrow cursor appears near the share/print icons at the right edge of the article column and drifts slightly. No text change.
Article scrolls up roughly one screen: header and headline leave frame, hero photo moves up and a Listen-now audio bar and a pull-quote appear at the bottom. Cursor moves.
Mouse arrow cursor over the hero photo shifts a few pixels between adjacent frames. Nothing else changes.
Article scrolls further: hero photo mostly leaves the top, body paragraphs and two bold subheadings enter. Cursor moves.
Mouse cursor changes between I-beam and arrow and moves over the body text; page and layout unchanged.
Cursor sits at the same position in all three views; no visible change in the text region.
Mouse arrow becomes an I-beam and moves up to the paragraph's first line; no content change.
A new character (hands at chin, open worried mouth, spiky hair) pops in at right of the article while blue text-selection is drawn over two lines and the 'Sizing up issuance' heading.
Blue selection edge on 'Sizing up issuance' and the cursor shift slightly; worried character static.
Blue text selection retracts: the two-line selection shrinks to 'through 2030,' and the heading selection to a stub; cursor moves left onto the line.
Selection on 'through 2030' shrinks further and the cursor slips left; small change in the paragraph area.
No visible content difference between pre and stable crops of the body text; at most a faint cursor shift.
Mouse arrow moves right and down across the article beside the character's head; selection and layout unchanged.
Cursor stays at the same place in pre, tile and stable crops; text unchanged.
Hard cut from article plus worried character to a dark-chrome PDF viewer: page-thumbnail sidebar on left, white page 'Financing the AI Buildout' on right, toolbar on top.
Mouse arrow moves to the top of the PDF viewer's right scrollbar; document unchanged.
Cursor rests on the scrollbar in both frames; no visible change in the document area.
PDF viewer scrolls from page 1 to page 4: page counter 1 to 4, thumbnail highlight steps down the sidebar, page text moves up; scrollbar thumb dragged downward.
Viewer chrome (toolbar, thumbnail strip, dark margins) scales out of frame while page 4 enlarges to full height at left-centre, leaving only the document text on white.
Smiling stick-figure presenter with a brown pointer stick pops in at right of the full-bleed document page, together with the first yellow highlight on the word 'Spread'.
Yellow marker highlight is drawn across three lines of the paragraph (from 'Spread over eight years' to 'roughly 2.8 percent of GDP'). Character static.
Hard cut from the document page and presenter to a cartoon green United States map with large eyes and a smile under the black text 'Every year.' on a white canvas.
Caption above the map changes from black 'Every year.' to larger red hand-lettered 'Through 2032.' at the same top-centre position; map unchanged.
Hard cut back to the highlighted document page; presenter now has a flat mouth, arms folded and the pointer held horizontally across his body at right.
Orange/amber marker highlight is drawn over the paragraph 'Historical comparisons help place this magnitude in context' across three lines, below the yellow highlight.
No visible difference between pre and stable in the highlighted paragraph; sub-threshold single-frame noise.
Hard cut from document and presenter to an otherwise blank white canvas holding only the grey chip/circuit-board prop at lower right.
Red 'Alphabet' wordmark pops in at upper left, then an 'amazon' wordmark with orange smile arrow pops in at top-centre three frames later. Stepped pop-ins.
Blue-infinity 'Meta' logo pops in left of centre, below the first two logos. Single-frame appearance.
Four-colour-square 'Microsoft' logo pops in at centre, right of the Meta logo. Single-frame appearance.
Red 'ORACLE' wordmark pops in at left, below Meta and Microsoft, completing a five-logo cluster above the chip prop. Single-frame appearance.
Many semi-transparent green dollar-bill sprites tumble down over the logo cluster and chip prop for about 58 frames, then a hard cut to a presenter beside an empty green chalkboard.
White chalk handwriting 'They've got the money for it, right?' appears on the green board and the presenter's pointer arm swings up to the board.
Hard cut to five company logos in a loose cluster under a wide jagged speech bubble reading 'DON'T touch my money', with four green money bags below.
